title: “I followed what felt right, not what I was told”: Autonomy, Coaching, and Recognizing Bias Through AI-Mediated Dialogue

bias_targets.methodology: A vignette-based experiment where participants engage in an AI-mediated dialogue with a simulated disabled character while receiving directional coaching nudges (biased, inclusive, or none). The study measures shifts in participants' ability to recognize ableist microaggressions by comparing pre- and post-intervention ratings of scenarios based on perceived standardness of social experience and emotional impact.
